# stefan: the world around the record

Everything here is fictional, and everything here is what the RECORD could
know. The one fact the record never learns is deliberately absent from
this file too; it lives only where the engine cannot read it.

## Household and people

- Kiel, Germany. A flat near the harbour, third floor, no lift, which he
  regards as training.
- Long divorced, on good terms; no children. Runs alone by preference,
  which his club (there is no club) would confirm if it existed.
- A sister in Flensburg. Family in the record only ever looks like a
  context row and a journal line.
- Colleagues at the dispatch office who know him as the man who runs at
  lunch when the tide tables allow. None of them appear in the record.

## Body and build

181 cm, 84 kg give or take half a kilo across an ordinary year. A
runner's legs on a dispatcher's posture.

## Transport and routine

Bicycle to the office in all weather; the car exists for the recycling
centre and the airfield loop's trailhead in winter. Shift-planned weeks:
earlies, lates, and the occasional weekend duty that moves the long run
to Sunday.

## Places

- **Grocery**: the Edeka on the corner, after the Tuesday run, still in
  running kit, always the same basket.
- **Gym**: none. He has opinions about gyms.
- **Pool**: none. He has stronger opinions about swimming.
- **The app and the watch**: intake typed in daily because round numbers
  please him; the watch worn always and consulted rarely.

## Route catalog

Ten years of the same three loops. The record's distances repeat because
his life does:

| Route | Distance | Shape | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| canal path | 5.2 km | out and back | Tuesday evenings, flat, lit |
| harbour bend | 8.4 km | single loop | Thursday evenings; the wind decides the pace |
| airfield loop | 15.5 km | single loop | weekend long run; gates open at six |

## Calendar and milestones

- 2029-11-10: registers for the Kiel half marathon (2030-03-24) and sets
  the only goal in his record: under 1:45, external, hard deadline.
- 2030-02-10: the build block begins, four weeks, honestly logged.
- 2030-03-24: race day. The record contains nothing on that date.
- 2030-05-19 to 25: a week in Flensburg, mode travel, "family week away".
- 2030-06-08: signs up for an autumn 10k, "nothing heroic".
